related.title: Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信；Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore改以矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication; Google TPU v5p and SparseCore centers on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照WSE本地core與SRAM與v5p TensorCore，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以晶圓與設施散熱為起點，設計一項能區分「本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信」與「矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare wse local cores and sram with v5p tensorcore and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Google TPU v5p and SparseCore, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from wafer/facility cooling and propose an observation distinguishing local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication from matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices, including uncertainty.
